# ghost/scoreboard

Scoreboard (F-Droid): add players, add rounds, set each player's score per round and read the table with totals. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/scoreboard
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/scoreboard add_player --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/scoreboard add_round --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/scoreboard set_score --device <serial> --param round=<round> --param player=<player> --param value=<value>
ghost skill run ghost/scoreboard get_scores --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `add_player`: Add a player called Anna to the scoreboard
- `add_round`: Add a new round to the scoreboard
- `set_score`: Give player 1 a score of 7 in round 1
- `get_scores`: Show the scoreboard
